content.text: ar be an-nikguele, anmar na dukin mas amioed,

content: A-ibagangine, Bab-Jehová, sapi-siklesad gannar ainiega imakoed. We-sapi-gannar-ainioedi, yeerdaklegedga guoed, degi, gandikidba-yeerdaklegedga gubaloed. Ibmar-durbamar-welemaloedi, Israel-dulemar-besmalad-e-nug-odummogega guoed, degi, e-nug-ogannogega gubaloed.
Degine, Sión-yalagi napi-dula-bemaloedi, Jerusalén-neggweburgi napi-dula-bukumaloedi, bilegoed: Dule-islidikidmarye, degi, bela Jerusalénʼgi-gudimalad-e-nug-narmakar-mamaidse-bakar, deyob bilegoed.
Bab-Dummad, sabsur-odurdakleged-igar mesnonikile, degi, geb sabsur-odurdakdele, omegan-Sión-yalaginmalad-e-isgued osulogoed, degi, Jerusalén-dulemar-ablis-eosmalad-e-isgued elioed.

Geb degine, Bab-Jehová, ibgine, Sión-yalagi, dulemar-ambikuoedgi mogir-gudure nasikoed. Mutikdi, ibegwar soo-gwabunye-gwichi imaknonikoed. Bab-Jehová-e-gangued-yeerdaklegedi atued-dummadyob-dakle bela neg-gasa naguoed.
Adi, ibgine, dad-ibeler-uedikgued-idu negsichii-imakedyob naguoed. Dii-wiedgi, degi, burwa-dummad-noedgi ega dukuedga naguoed.
